history.content: I'm 23, love dogs, and don't have a car. I need something close to where I live.

I found several dog-related volunteer roles in Greater New Haven. I can’t tell which is close without your town, and the listings say to confirm with the organizations rather than confirming openings.

I found two dog-focused possibilities: one listed in New Haven, though its work site isn’t confirmed, and a dog-walking role in North Haven. Neither listing confirms a current placement; sharing a ZIP for approximate distance estimates is optional.

Yale SOM isn’t enough to estimate distance, and I can’t infer a ZIP from it. One dog-care listing is in New Haven, though its exact site is unconfirmed; another is at a verified site in North Haven. Neither confirms a current placement. A ZIP is optional for approximate distance estimates.
